what: A cluster of illustration pieces (buildings, trees, people) sits transparent at the lower right (cluster x 10~30 · y 80~100, each piece 5~10 more), tilted .3~.5π. When it enters the screen (or right on open), it bounces into place over 2.25s at .015s intervals — height wobbles big with elastic.out(4, .75), sideways power4.out, tilt elastic.out(1, 1), opacity .9s expo.out. A Hero where a park illustration pops out piece by piece

options.[data-fx-part=piece]: Bouncing pieces (children, multiple) — if none, the direct children
options.on: If ”load”, starts as soon as it opens. Otherwise plays once when it enters the screen

note: Pieces rotate around the bottom center (for SVG pieces, the consumer side should use fill-box for transform-box). The wobble size is random on each open (as in the original) · side distance and tilt are the original mm random numbers — with even odds the sign of the start value flips (mm(a, b) = a~b or −a~b−2a) also comes from the left and the opposite tilt

from.where: shared.js pop() (hero park art·borders·shops·others·neighborhood map pieces) — original qP.show/VP.show/KP.show values as is
